observations.seen: Warm pink-orange sunset key with a low sun disc behind the left spires. Shading on spires and islands is mostly flat toon bands with little 3/4 front modelling, so the scene reads as dusk rather than outdoor day.

The ball casts a soft dark contact blob and the gates cast readable shadows across the track in frames 1 and 2. Spires, islands and bead rails show no visible cast shadows, and the ball shadow is a smudge with no defined shape.

The red ball has a strong glossy highlight and rim, and the bead rails have small specular dots. The track shows mirrored ghost copies of the gates that look like a screen-space or planar reflection on a surface textured as wood, which conflicts with the material.

Floating grassy islands with towers, hot-air balloons, rows of wooden spires, pennant bunting and a cloud sea below. The world is dense and themed, with a winding track that stays readable into the distance.
Distance haze fades the far track and spires into pink. White speed-line streaks cross the sky. The haze density is much heavier than the 0.0025 recipe and is tinted magenta, not daylight blue.

Paint-drip gates, red paint splats on the track, a lightly textured wood plank surface and a glossy candy ball. The materials hold together stylistically, but the faceted clouds and spires are plain flat colour.
Assets are low-poly with clean silhouettes: drip-edged gates, beaded rails, lighthouse-like towers, balloons. Clouds are visibly faceted and the spires are simple extruded prisms.

Centred one-point perspective with the vanishing point near the top third. In frames 1 and 2 the ball fills about 5–6% of the frame, and in frame 4 about 1%, well under the 18–25% target. The large paint splash and the speed lines add clutter at the bottom and top.

The camera is a high behind-the-ball chase view looking down the track, not the side-on follow the recipe specifies. The FOV appears wider than 50°, judging by the strong rail convergence and the stretched near beads.

Dark outline pass on the ball, beads and HUD-adjacent objects, a soft glow on the track mid-ground, and a pink colour grade. Frame 3 uses a blurred, desaturated backdrop behind the menu card. The grade is sunset, not daylight-outdoor.

Rounded cream pill panels for score and combo, heart balloons for lives, a colour orb with a meter, a 2x 5s timer pill under the ball, and a clean title card with Play button, accessibility toggles and control hints. All text is legible and consistent in style.
